confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Thai price levels, not checked against live menus, booking pages or listings, and brought forward to July 2026 at modest price growth. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; room rates vary by neighborhood and season, and the 3-star and private hostel anchors are least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from a local price relationship to the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 2.8x) because direct bar and wine knowledge is weaker. Baht conversions assume about 33 THB per USD. FX value taken from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Basis is Southeast Asia with Thai price levels for a northern tourist hub, placed below Bangkok and Phuket and broadly in line with other Thai provincial tourist cities.
